name: @starter/agentic
description: A Bun and TypeScript base for projects built by parallel coding agents in separate Git worktrees.

scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.policy:check: nudge validate && bun tools/check-nudge-rules.ts && nudge check && bastion validate && eph check
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run policy:check
